description: Connects Otter.ai (transcription), Granola (structured meeting notes), and Mem (knowledge storage) into a unified meeting intelligence workflow for Loxihart and FlashFusion. Routes each meeting to the right capture tool, runs a post-meeting processing protocol within 24 hours, and stores distilled context where it can be retrieved. Activates when the user mentions: meeting notes, capture this meeting, Otter, Granola, Mem, PKM, after a call, after a workshop, what did we decide, what was discussed, meeting recap, log this conversation, store this context, note from today, or any request to capture or retrieve context from a meeting or conversation.
